gasoline.name: Gasoline
gasoline.where: Gas stations, jerry cans in garages, siphoned from cars
gasoline.effect: Standard. Spilled, it spreads fast, makes the air shimmer, catches fire and evaporates in 60 s.

ethanol.name: Ethanol (alcohol)
ethanol.where: Gas stations and mills in the countryside
ethanol.effect: A cold engine fails to start on cold nights. Can be distilled at a mill with power.

flex.name: Flex
flex.shelf_life: That of whatever is in the tank
flex.effect: Accepts any mix of gasoline and ethanol.

diesel.name: Diesel
diesel.effect: Louder engine and black smoke at high revs.

electric.name: Electric
electric.where: Outlet with a generator, solar panel or mall charger
electric.effect: Almost silent (15 m). Slow recharge, in hours. A damaged battery can catch fire.

hybrid.name: Hybrid
hybrid.where: Gas stations; the battery recharges while driving
hybrid.effect: Silent electric mode below 40 km/h. The engine starts by itself when the battery runs low.

avgas.name: Aviation gasoline (AVGAS)
avgas.effect: Rare. Works in a car, but car gasoline does not work in an aircraft.

jet_fuel.name: Jet fuel (Jet A-1)
jet_fuel.effect: Turbines only. A turbine helicopter is heard from 450 m.

part_effects.headlight: Broken headlight: no light on that side at night.
part_effects.taillight: Broken taillight: whoever is behind cannot see the vehicle brake.
part_effects.wheel: Punctured tire: the vehicle pulls to that side.
part_effects.bumper: Loose bumper: it hangs and the next hit goes straight into the bodywork.
part_effects.hood: Dented hood: it stays ajar and blocks the view.
part_effects.radiator: Punctured radiator: white smoke and the engine overheats in minutes.
part_effects.engine: Damaged engine: loses power, leaks oil that drips and spreads.
part_effects.fuel_tank: Punctured tank: the gasoline spreads fast, is flammable and evaporates in 60 s.
part_effects.battery: Damaged battery: catches fire and gives off black smoke, charging blocked.
part_effects.cargo: Dented body: the rear door jams.
part_effects.hull: Punctured hull: water comes in and the boat sinks slowly.
part_effects.propeller: Bent propeller: the plane cannot take off.
part_effects.wing: Damaged wing: the plane cannot take off safely.
part_effects.landing_gear: Broken landing gear: the landing becomes a crash.
part_effects.rotor: Damaged main rotor: the helicopter cannot take off.
part_effects.tail_rotor: Damaged tail rotor: the helicopter spins out of control.
part_effects.track: Broken track: the armored vehicle can only turn in place.
part_effects.armor: Armor hit: sparks only, no dents.
part_effects.explosion: Hood, doors and a wheel torn off; the wreck burns and the vehicle no longer moves.

jet_ski.name: Si-Dú Spark
jet_ski.description: Small, light and nervous, with a jet pump instead of a propeller. Jumps waves and escapes through shallow channels.

sailboat.name: Delta 26 Sailboat
sailboat.category: 26 ft ocean sailboat (sail and auxiliary diesel engine)
sailboat.description: Sail by day, a 10 hp engine when the wind dies. Slow, but crosses to the horizon without a fuel station.
sailboat.efficiency: ≈ 1.5 L/h on the engine · zero under sail
sailboat.range: ≈ 250 km on the engine · unlimited under sail

rescue_dinghy.name: Zodiaque Rescue
rescue_dinghy.category: Inflatable rescue boat with outboard motor
rescue_dinghy.description: Rubber floats that do not sink even with one chamber punctured. Goes into the flood and comes out with people hanging on the rope.

patrol_boat.name: Patrol Boat
patrol_boat.description: Aluminium hull, two water jets and a machine gun on the bow. Goes up a shallow river and backs out without a rudder.

boxy_hatch.name: Unno Mille
boxy_hatch.description: The little box that survived everything. Light, high off the ground and with parts at any scrapyard. This one came with the electrician's ladder on the roof: handy for climbing walls and roofs.

family_hatch.name: Gól G5
family_hatch.description: The best-selling car of a whole decade. Well-known mechanics, firm suspension and a small trunk. Easy to find parked on any street.

rideshare_hatch.name: HB-21
rideshare_hatch.description: A modern ride-share fleet hatchback. Economical, comfortable and full of electronics nobody knows how to fix any more.

turbo_hatch.name: Pólo
turbo_hatch.description: A small turbo engine and very firm on the highway. Quick to escape, economical to travel, but the electronics suffer without a workshop.

fastback_sedan.name: Cívico
fastback_sedan.description: A low, wide sedan with a high-revving engine. Very fast on the highway, but scrapes the bumper on every speed bump or pile of rubble.

classic_six_sedan.name: Opalla Comodoro
classic_six_sedan.description: Inline six, rear-wheel drive and thick old-style sheet metal. Drinks a lot, but takes a beating and pushes stopped cars out of the street.

v8_coupe.name: Mustangue GT
v8_coupe.description: Five-litre V8 and rear-wheel drive. The fastest in the garage on a straight, but the tank vanishes quickly.

box_truck.name: Delivéri 11.180 Box
box_truck.description: Narrow forward cab, wedge headlights and a 5.5 m box. Keeps supplies locked away. The cab tilts to show the 4-cylinder diesel.

tanker_truck.name: Constellation 24.280 Tanker
tanker_truck.description: Tall cab with a black grille and an elliptical 20,000-litre petrol tank. One shot at the tank and the street explodes. The cab tilts to show the 6-cylinder diesel.

school_bus.name: ON School
school_bus.description: The yellow school bus of the countryside: tall, sturdy and front-engined. Double door behind the wheel, 44 seated students and no discretion at all. The front cover opens onto the engine.

city_bus.name: Marcopólo Torino
city_bus.description: The line bus of the capitals: giant windshield, LED destination sign and two wide doors. Low floor, turnstile and a rear engine with an opening cover.

armored_truck.name: Atego Armored
armored_truck.description: Armored forward cab and a steel vault with gun ports. Bulletproof glass. Heavy and thirsty, but nobody gets in. The cab tilts for the diesel.

tractor.name: Massei 275
tractor.description: The red tractor of every farm: long hood, big rear wheels and a roll bar with an awning. Slow, but it never gets stuck and pushes stopped cars. The hood opens to show the four-cylinder diesel.

trainer_helicopter.name: Robinsom R22
trainer_helicopter.description: The school helicopter. Light, cheap and twitchy on the controls. Lands on any slab, but carries only two people and almost no cargo.

turbine_helicopter.name: Bel 206 Jet
turbine_helicopter.description: Small turbine, five seats and a reputation for being indestructible. Air taxi, news and police: there is one on every big-city heliport.

police_helicopter.name: H-145 Eagle
police_helicopter.description: The police helicopter. Two engines, a thermal camera, a searchlight and a winch: finds people stuck on a roof at night and still lowers a rope.

attack_helicopter.name: Sabre AH-2
attack_helicopter.inspired: Mil Mi-35M (AH-2 Sabre of the Brazilian Air Force)
attack_helicopter.description: A flying tank: armoured, armed with a twin cannon and rockets, and still carries eight soldiers in the middle. Loud and thirsty.

light_4x4.name: Maruá AM2
light_4x4.description: Two-door military jeep with a canvas top and a folding windshield. Climbs banks, fords 60 cm streams and carries six with gear.

troop_truck.name: Worqer 15.210 Military
troop_truck.description: Tilting forward cab, 4x4 drive and a canvas body with two wooden benches. Carries a whole platoon or five tonnes of supplies.

apc_6x6.name: Guaraní 6x6
apc_6x6.description: Wedge hull with sloped sides, six wheels and a weapon station on the roof. Floats, carries eleven and withstands rifle fire from every side.

armored_car_6x6.name: Cascável EE-9
armored_car_6x6.description: Wedge bow, rear rocker bogie and a turret with a 90 mm gun. Fast on asphalt, breaks through barricades and the crew sees everything through the periscopes.

battle_tank.name: Leopard 1A5
battle_tank.description: Forty tonnes on tracks, a wedge turret and a 105 mm gun. Drives over cars and walls. Drinks diesel like nothing else and is heard from afar.

transport_helicopter.name: Black Falcon HM-2
transport_helicopter.description: Twin turboshafts, a four-blade rotor and wide sliding doors. Pulls eleven soldiers off a surrounded roof and survives rifle fire on the blades.

compact_hatch.name: Ônyx
compact_hatch.description: The most common car in town. Economical, nimble and fragile. Spare parts in any garage.

taxi.name: Ônyx Plus Taxi
taxi.description: White sedan with a roof sign and the cooperative radio. Big trunk for groceries.

entry_hatch.name: Kwyd
entry_hatch.description: Light, high off the ground and cheap to keep. Fits in any alley, but the thin bodywork dents easily.

electric_hatch.name: Dolfin
electric_hatch.description: Needs power to recharge; a damaged battery catches fire.

midsize_sedan.name: Corola
midsize_sedan.description: A balance of comfort, trunk space and speed. Reliable to the end of the world.

police_sedan.name: Cruzi Patrol
police_sedan.description: Turbo engine, beacon, siren and a grille separating the back seat. Radio and weapons cabinet empty.

highway_police_sedan.name: Cruzi Highway
highway_police_sedan.description: The same patrol car in the highway police livery: white with blue and yellow stripes. Found parked at roadside checkpoints.

bicycle.name: Monarch Circular Bar
bicycle.description: The classic steel bicycle with a double curved top bar and a rear rack. Silent, fuel-free and fully exposed.

scooter.name: PXC 160
scooter.description: Automatic gearbox, flat floor and a trunk under the seat. Easy to ride through the abandoned traffic jam; small wheels struggle on dirt.

commuter_motorcycle.name: Titan 160
commuter_motorcycle.description: The best-selling motorcycle in the country: slips between stopped cars and can be fixed with any part.

trail_bike.name: Brós 160
trail_bike.description: Long-travel suspension and knobby tyres: climbs banks and crosses mud on trails where cars cannot go.

adventure_bike.name: GZ 1250 Adventure
adventure_bike.description: Boxer engine, 30-litre tank and aluminium panniers. Crosses the country without stopping at a station, but it is too heavy to lift alone.

highway_police_bike.name: GZ 1250 Highway
highway_police_bike.description: The highway police big trail: white and blue, striped panniers, siren and lights on the engine guard. Built to ride hundreds of kilometres a day on the highway.

quad_bike.name: Grizzli 700
quad_bike.description: 4x4 drive and racks front and rear. Good on the farm and in the bush; unstable at speed and with no protection at all.

beetle.name: Fusquinha 1300
beetle.description: Air-cooled engine at the back, no radiator to puncture. Simple mechanics: anyone can fix it with a wrench and some wire. Noisy and slow, but it never dies.

step_through_scooter.name: Bis 125
step_through_scooter.description: The low step-through scooter: you can ride it in a skirt, a helmet fits under the seat and it runs almost 50 km on a litre. Small wheels and little protection.

naked_bike.name: Fazê 250
naked_bike.description: A 250 cc naked bike with an LED headlight and a muscular tank. More stamina than the 160s for escaping on the highway, without losing the city-bike character.

sport_bike.name: Ninjá 400
sport_bike.description: A light twin-cylinder sport bike: tops 180 km/h on an empty road. Racing posture and plastic fairings that crack on the first fall.

cruiser.name: Fat Boi 114
cruiser.description: A heavy custom with solid wheels and a 1.9-litre V2 engine. The torque drags away any obstacle.

delivery_bike.name: Titan 160 Cargo
delivery_bike.description: The courier's bike: rider-only seat, steel rack and a delivery box. The box carries medicine, food and ammunition across the occupied city.

tandem_trainer.name: Paipa Cub
tandem_trainer.category: Single-engine trainer, high wing, 2 seats in tandem
tandem_trainer.description: The little yellow flying-club plane. Lands in pastures, dirt roads and clearings, and takes off in 150 m. Little fuel and almost no protection.

regional_turboprop.name: Bandeirantte EMB-110
regional_turboprop.description: The plane that linked the Brazilian interior. Lands on short dirt strips, carries sixteen people and cargo, and has two engines: lose one and it still gets home.

amphibian_turboprop.name: Caravan Amphibian
amphibian_turboprop.description: Lands on rivers, reservoirs and runways. In the Amazon it becomes bus, ambulance and truck. The floats take the knocks, but getting stuck on the bank is a risk.

light_jet.name: Fenom 100
light_jet.description: A businessman's little jet. Fast, high and pressurised: gets people out of a lost city in an hour, if there is a whole asphalt runway.

light_attack_turboprop.name: Super Tucanno
light_attack_turboprop.category: Light attack and advanced training turboprop, 2 seats in tandem
light_attack_turboprop.description: Light attack and advanced training turboprop. Flies low and slow, with two .50 calibres in the wings and rockets on the pylons.

compact_suv.name: T-Crux
compact_suv.description: City compact SUV: high enough to jump kerbs, short enough to manoeuvre between abandoned cars. The flex turbo drinks whatever it finds.

hybrid_suv.name: Corola Crux Hybrid
hybrid_suv.description: Runs silently in electric mode around town and starts the flex engine on the highway. A damaged hybrid battery can catch fire.

midsize_suv.name: Compas Longitude
midsize_suv.description: Seven-slot grille, black roof and 4x4 drive with diesel. Comfortable on the road and firm on dirt.

large_suv.name: Hylux SW-4
large_suv.description: Tall, heavy and built on a pickup chassis. Seven seats, low range and diesel: takes the whole family out of the city.

compact_pickup.name: Estrada Crew Cab
compact_pickup.description: The best-selling pickup in the country: light, economical and with a bed for 650 kg. No 4x4, but parts can be found in any town.

crossover_pickup.name: Bull Ultra
crossover_pickup.description: A pickup that looks like an SUV: headlights split into two levels, a tailgate that opens like a door, and 4x4 diesel.

midsize_pickup.name: Hylux Double Cab
midsize_pickup.description: The survivors' favourite: strong chassis, low range, roll bar and a bed for one tonne.

monster_truck.name: Bigfut
monster_truck.description: An old pickup body on top of 1.68 m tyres. Drives over cars and walls. The supercharged V8 wakes the whole city.

cargo_van.name: Sprinta Van
cargo_van.description: High roof, sliding side door and 1.9 tonnes of cargo. No traction for mud, but a whole camp fits in the back.

ambulance.name: Ducatto Rescue
ambulance.description: Van with a stretcher, an oxygen cylinder and a medicine cabinet. Great for carrying the wounded.
ambulance.seats: 3 in the cab + 2 in the back + 1 stretcher

river_skiff.name: Levfort Marajó
river_skiff.description: Semi-flat-bottom aluminium boat, the taxi of the rivers. Light, fast and noisy.

speedboat.name: Foker 240
speedboat.description: Deep-V hull and a 250 hp outboard motor. An escape route across the reservoir with the whole family.

fishing_boat.name: Hope Trawler
fishing_boat.description: Wooden hull with a deckhouse aft and tyre fenders. You can live aboard, far from the shore.

single_engine_plane.name: Sesna 172
single_engine_plane.description: Flying-club plane. High wing, fixed gear and four seats. Needs a clear runway and aviation gasoline.

crop_duster.name: Ipanemá EMB-203
crop_duster.description: Ethanol-powered crop plane. Lands on dirt strips and the spray boom can spread bait or fire.

piston_helicopter.name: Robinsom R44
piston_helicopter.description: Four seats, a two-blade rotor and a piston engine. Light enough to land on a building roof.

rescue_helicopter.name: Esquillo AS350
rescue_helicopter.description: Turbine, a three-blade rotor, a searchlight and a rescue winch. Pulls people off surrounded roofs.
